verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature docs cover agile sprint templates, burn down charts, capacity management, and board views, and a community comment on closed sprints confirms sprints exist in practice. One user complains that viewing tickets in a closed sprint is difficult, which is a usability gripe rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of sprint planning mechanics (backlog grooming, starting and completing sprints, sprint scope changes), and independent hands-on corroboration that sprint management works smoothly.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development

citations.quote: Start fast with pre-built and customizable templates for any project, from agile sprints to marketing campaigns.
Keep work on track whether you're measuring engineering cycle time, burn down charts, or managing capacity.
Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
